# Daya — independent consultant: decision research & product discovery

> I help companies decide what to build, buy, or change — before the money gets spent.
> Interviews, research, and technical analysis that turn a vague initiative into a decision
> the client can defend: options weighed, scope defined, requirements a team or vendor can
> execute. Remote, worldwide. Works in English and Russian.

## Services
- **Decision & Discovery Sprint** (core offer, 1–2 weeks, fixed price) — stakeholder
  interviews, problem & process analysis, market and solution scan, build-vs-buy comparison.
  Deliverable: a decision brief with a scoped first version, requirements, and risks that
  can be handed to a team or vendor.
- **Technical & Market Assessment** — independent evaluation of a market, vendor, or
  technology: verified claims, comparisons against measurable criteria, diligence-style
  research for investors. Deliverable: an evidence-based brief separating what is known,
  assumed, and unknown, with sources and a recommendation.
- **Fractional Discovery Lead** (ongoing, after a sprint) — a few days a month: continued
  interviews, requirements kept current, translation between business stakeholders and the
  people building.

Typical clients: CEOs, COOs and heads of product/operations at tech-enabled companies
(roughly 20–200 people), corporate product and innovation teams, software and automation
agencies that want discovery run with their clients before quoting (white-label welcome),
and investors needing diligence-style research.

AI adoption work is available but deliberately not the headline: an AI decision is still a
decision, and it is handled inside sprints and assessments rather than as a separate
"AI strategy" package.

## Background
The same craft practiced in four rooms: a venture fund, AI/LLM development, blockchain
infrastructure, and academic research. At a venture fund: helped the CEO widen the
investment thesis beyond a single ecosystem, screened ~100 early-stage companies, ran
15–20 structured founder interviews in payments and fintech, and designed evaluation
benchmarks used to award ecosystem funding. Peer-reviewed publication on community
tokenization tooling (DOI: 10.17587/it.31.258-270). Builds with LLMs, reads code, ships
an independent AI product.

## Working principles
- Every engagement ends in a document the client owns.
- Every claim is labeled: known, assumed, or unknown — and what would settle it.
- No conviction for sale: if the research contradicts the hoped-for answer, the client hears it.
- If the client doesn't need the work, they're told so on the first call.

## How to work together
1. A free 30-minute call.
2. A fixed-price Decision & Discovery Sprint, 1–2 weeks, small scope, real deliverable.
3. A defined project or a few days a month as fractional discovery lead — only if the sprint earned it.

## Not a fit for
Validating a decision already made; confidence delivered regardless of the data;
full-time employment; answers that must arrive before the research does.
